statement: Every circuit here acts on at most eight wires, so its state is at most 256 amplitudes and is simulated exactly on a classical computer; QCNNs on classical data of this kind are classically simulable (Bermejo et al., PRX Quantum 7, 020304, 2026). No quantum advantage is claimed.

medical.citation: Wolberg, Mangasarian, Street & Street, 'Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)', UCI Machine Learning Repository (1993), doi:10.24432/C5DW2B, CC BY 4.0.

telecom.dataset: QKD attack telemetry (synthetic, signatures of this project's own design)
telecom.citation: 8 classes = 7 attack types + normal, per Al-Kuwari et al. (IET Quantum Communication 7(1), e70028, 2026). The class list follows the paper; the 7 features and their signature values are this project's own design: illustrative, not fitted to any measurement. No public real QKD-attack capture was found (arXiv:2508.12749 reports anomalies recorded on an experimental QKD receiver and states no data release); this is labelled synthetic everywhere it is reported. The rows are written by this repository's generator (qsh.qml_ids.attacks), and they and the weights trained on them are released under the repository's licence, Apache-2.0.
